name: Handheld Quaker Mk 2
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
description: This small toy-like device has a hidden mechanism meant to be activated by the user, but the centuries have eroded its magical-mechanical components to the point that they activate at the slightest touch.
disable: DC 22 Thievery (trained) to deactivate the mechanism; DC 20 Crafting (trained) to identify and repair the problem components; two successes are required to disable the hazard
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without a creature being within 5' of the handheld quaker.
routine:
At its initiative, to determine what the quaker does, roll 1d4 and consult the following table:

1: No action

2: A small quake: the terrain in a 10ft Type:emanation centered on the quaker shakes briefly. A creature in an affected square is knocked Prone (Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save).

3: A medium quake: the terrain within the vault shakes constantly, transforming it into difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is knocked prone and takes 2d8 Bludgeoning Damage damage from the fall (Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save).

4: A great quake: the terrain within the vault moves in waves, transforming it into greater difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is violently slammed to the ground, knocked prone and taking (2d8+6) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Quake!
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves into a space with the handheld quaker or interacts with it

Effect The handheld quaker vibrates visibly and rolls initiative.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shaking Earth
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature within difficult terrain created by the quaker takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves and actions with the Manipulate trait, including Disable Device.
